basic_info.description: Gorgeous period details blend seamlessly with modern updates in this sun-drenched, full-floor top-level condo with exclusive use two-car deeded garage, shared roof deck, and in-unit laundry  all in a charming two-unit corner building with a 99 WalkScore/100 BikeScore in the heart of the Mission. Light-filled and semi-detached, the home sits beside a lush public garden and features soaring ceilings, multiple bay windows, and an open living/dining room with original moldings. The renovated eat-in kitchen is the perfect blend of form and function, with quartz countertops, ceramic tile backsplash, Wolf range, Bosch dishwasher, LG fridge, and a huge walk-in pantry. Three spacious bedrooms include a bright primary with a huge circular bay window framing iconic views of Twin Peaks and Bernal Hill. Updated full bath with solid wood double vanity and new tile floor. Freshly painted and newly refinished, warm, wood floors throughout. Deeded, private garage parking for two cars, generous storage, and a sun-drenched, wind protected shared roof deck with wraparound views. Steps to 24th Street corridor, Flour & Water, Gus's, MUNI, BART, tech shuttles, and 101/280. You can have it all!
